title: CS2040S - Data Structures and Algorithms - World of Seven
description: # CS2040S - Data Structures and Algorithms (Java). This course introduces students to the design and implementation of fundamental data structures and algorithms. The course covers basic data structures (linked lists, stacks, queues, binary heaps, hash tables, trees, and graphs), searching and sorting algorithms, and basic analysis of algorithms. The programming language used for this course is Java. We use **very** basic object-oriented programming concepts in various data structures implementations, e.g., Stack class inherits LinkedList class (more details of OOP are in CS2030). For AY 2026/27, Prof Halim only teaches CS2040S (CS students) in S1. Generally: the higher your past teaching feedback rating of related course(s) (for senior TAs), your CS2040/C/S grade (for new TAs), the higher your LeetCode rating/number of solves, the higher your chance to be TA of this course.**. From AY 2017/18 until the present, he has received teaching feedback ratings from 4.2 (average) to 4.8 (very good) out of a maximum of 5.0 for these offerings, with a running average rating of 4.469 (good).
